messages:
Alex P.: Morning — quick heads-up: marketplace reported odd GC/ooms on our AMI with CUDA 12.2 + driver 535.86. Can partners confirm any known regressions? @Ben (NVIDIA) @Maria G.?
Maria G.: saw it in the US-west smoke yesterday, small sample set. Repro on p4d with 32k seq. Symptoms: kernel panic in nvgpu stack and repeated process kills. Will share logs shortly.
Samir K.: pinging infra. Do we want to pin to 535.54 or roll forward to 536.x? My vote: pin first, then test roll-forward in a gated canary.
Jing L.: I'd prefer pin to 535.54 for stability. 535.86 looks suspect. Recommend a short-lived pin + hotfix path.
Ben (NVIDIA): looking into this now. There's a known regression introduced around 535.80 related to page-table handling for very large vram allocations. Patch is in 536.01. Short term: 535.54 is the safest pin. We'll share internal notes in a moment.
Marketplace Ops: customers seeing ~2% increase in retries and one high-severity complaint from a finops customer. Rolling back to previous golden image would be the fastest mitigation.
Alex P.: Ok action items: (1) Marketplace -> rollback canary to image with driver 535.54, (2) NVIDIA -> confirm 536.01 backport ETA, (3) Eng-runtime -> add quick detection metric for kernel OOMs. Who wants which?
Maria G.: I'll own the canary rollback. Starting now. /cc @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: rolling back canary: `deploy/marketplace-image` -> `image:v2026.03.12-driver53554` ... started. ETA ~5m :gear:
Samir K.: I’ll add detection rule: `nvgpu_kill_count > 0` alert to canary dashboards and a short playbook. Will send PR.
Ben (NVIDIA): ETA for upstream stable 536.01 is ~2 business days; a targeted backport may be available same-day depending on test results. I'll post the patch link when it's ready.
Jing L.: In parallel, let's prepare a short customer-facing note for marketplace partners: symptoms, mitigation (rollback or wait for patch), and contact path. I'll draft and share here.
Alex P.: Great. Maria, post canary result here. Samir, link PR. Ben, paste the patch link when ready. Thanks :thumbsup:
Marketplace Ops: rollback complete, canary traffic healthy, errors down to baseline. Will monitor for 30m and escalate if anything else pops up.
Samir K.: PR -> https://git.redwood/repo/infra-alerts/pull/412 (added rule + playbook).
Ben (NVIDIA): Patch link (secure): https://nvlink.nvidia.com/patches/536.01/bugfix-ptb — shared with partners via secure channel.
Jing L.: Drafted comms: "We're aware of increased OOMs with driver 535.86 on large-sequence inference. Mitigation: rollback to 535.54 or wait for 536.01 patch. Contact marketplace-support for assisted rollback." Posting to stakeholders now.
Alex P.: Filing a follow-up sync tomorrow 10:00am PT with partners to confirm rollout/backport plan and communication cadence. If anyone can't make, ping here. Closing this thread for now.
opsbot: scheduled: `partner-driver-alignment-sync` -> 2026-03-13 17:00 UTC
